Nina: Quick check 11 final topic for 5/12 webinar: "Practical inference tradeoffs for product teams". Want two short demos + a customer vignette. OK?
Omar: Sounds good. Recommend one demo on cost (caching) and one on latency (kernel/runtime).
Leah: I can take the caching demo (7m). Will prepare a 2-min backup clip.
Tom: I'll do the runtime kernel demo (8m). Need 30m green-room rehearsal.
Nina: Rehearsal options: 5/10 10:00 PT or 5/11 16:00 PT. Which works?
Leah: 5/11 16:00 PT works.
Tom: Prefer 5/10 10:00 PT but can do 5/11 if needed.
Omar: Slide owners: @Nina final narrative, @Omar benchmark slides, @Leah & @Tom demo slides. Drop to /marketing/shared/decks/may12 by 5/6 EOD.
Nina: Lead routing: simple checkboxes on reg form (product/infra). We'll tag and route to SDRs. @ops-bot can you confirm form integration with CDP?
ops-bot: CDP integration available. Set utm_campaign=may12_inference; mapping to tags supported.
Leah: Abstract: "Caching patterns that cut token spend without sacrificing tail latency." Bio: "Leah	4 Staff Infra Engineer."
Tom: Abstract: "Kernel and runtime knobs for predictable latency at scale." Bio: "Tom	4 Runtime Engineer."
Nina: OK great. Small ops: please upload backup clips to s3://redwood-webinar/may12/ by 5/9.
Omar: Will produce two benchmark slides (cost vs latency) with test config snippet: {"model":"redwood-13b","seq_len":4096,"batch":4}.
Nina: Closing: abstracts + bios due 5/5 EOD; rehearsal invite after that. Thanks! :rocket:
